## Research Summary

### Root Cause
The issue is caused by a **Zellij cache bug** ([zellij-org/zellij#3590](https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/issues/3590)): OSC 10/11 queries return incorrect colors (always black) due to a caching problem. This causes opencode to incorrectly detect dark mode.

### Terminal Detection Flow
1. opencode queries terminal background via 
2. Zellij returns black due to cache bug
3. opencode detects dark background → applies dark mode

### Affected Modules
-  - Theme detection
-  - Config validation

### Proposed Solution (PR #15612)
Add  config option to :

Valid values: , ,  (default)

### Priority Order
1.  (manual override) - highest
2.  - persisted preference  
3. Terminal detection (default)

### Alternative Fix
Upgrade Zellij to 0.43.1+ which fixes the underlying cache issue.

### Risks
- Low: Backward compatible (optional config)
- Works for JetBrains IDE terminals which have similar issues
